request.original_text:
请为正丁烷（中性、单重态、气相）扫描四个相连碳原子定义的中心C-C-C-C二面角。自行选择一种方法和基组并说明依据；先在-180、-120、-60、0、60、120、180度七个指定角度做保持该二面角的约束优化，记录每个实际角度、优化是否收敛和电子能量，画出相对能量曲线。请在粗扫结果出来前说明你将如何根据数值结果判断是否需要局部加密；粗扫完成后把观察交回主决策循环，再根据该判据和曲线作出继续或停止决定。如果需要加密，最多新增2个未计算角度；不需要时不要追加计算，并解释理由。交付所有点的结构、数据、曲线、初始结构、原始证据和失败清单；不要把未收敛点当成功点，或把离散扫描峰值宣称为已验证过渡态。

若结构生成、搜索或其他算法使用随机数，请统一采用种子 1701 并在报告中记录；若某一库或模型不支持固定种子，明确记为不可固定，不伪造确定性。

document_excerpt.title: ORCA 6.1 Geometry Optimization
document_excerpt.query: constraints fixed dihedral angle Constraints block syntax
document_excerpt.excerpt:
ORCA is able to calculate equilibrium structures (minima and transition states) using the quasi Newton update procedure with the well known BFGS update [530, 531, 532, 533, 534, 535], the Powell or the Bofill update. The optimization can be carried out in either redundant internal (recommended in most cases) or Cartesian displacement coordinates. As initial Hessian the user can choose between a diagonal initial Hessian, several model Hessians (Swart, Lindh, Almloef, Schlegel), an exact Hessian and a partially exact Hessian (both recommended for transition state optimization) for both coordinate types. In redundant internal coordinates several options for the type of step to be taken exist. The user can define constraints via two different paths. He can either define them directly (as bond length, angle, dihedral or Cartesian constraints) or he can define several fragments and constrain the fragments internally and with respect to other fragments. The ORCA optimizer can be used as an external optimizer, i.e.the energy and gradient calculations done by ORCA.

In a first step, bonds are constructed between atom pairs which fulfill certain (atom type specific) distance criteria. If there are fragments in the system, which are not connected to each other (this is the case when there are two or more separate molecules), an additional bond is assigned to the nearest atom pair between the nonbonded fragments. All other internal coordinates are constructed on the basis of this set of bonds. Here, in a second step, bond angles are constructed between the atoms of directly neighboured bonds. If such an angle reaches more than 175\(^{\circ}\), a special type of linear angles is constructed. In a third step, dihedral angles (and improper torsions) are constructed between the atoms of directly neighbouring angles.

Constraints {B 1 2 value C} Constrain bond between atoms 1 and N.
